description: Read one page of a list that an earlier Enrich Layer answer left out because of its size. Pass a `cursor` from that answer's `more`, or the `nextCursor` or `restartCursor` of a page, exactly as it was returned. Every call is a new lookup of the same profile, read from the cached copy and asking only for the section that holds the list, and it is charged like that lookup: `creditCost` of the page is what was charged. For the few profiles the source can serve only live, a page costs more. A page holds whole items in their original order (time series oldest first) and is never longer than 24,000 bytes; `nextCursor` is null after the last page. Calling the same cursor again returns the same page and is charged again. If the list changed since the earlier pages, the page says so and gives `restartCursor` to read it again from the start.

cursor.description: A `cursor`, `nextCursor` or `restartCursor` from an earlier Enrich Layer answer, exactly as it was returned.

name: get_more
title: Get More
